name: plc_batch_get
description: Read durable batch progress together with the enclosing job. Journal state verified is internal evidence, not proof that the managed version has published. This does not resume or unlock an unknown job.

name: plc_capabilities_list
description: List planned PLC engineering capabilities and their verification status. Production blocks unverified capabilities. The separate validation host can execute explicitly allowlisted operations as unverified.

name: plc_delivery_create
description: Package an exact managed revision with project files, hashes, dependencies, task bindings and successful compilation evidence from a private copy. Does not advance the workspace head. Fixture evidence remains simulated; vendor evidence remains unverified.

name: plc_delivery_read
description: Read ZIP bytes in bounded base64 chunks. Verify each chunk and the complete SHA-256 from the create result before accepting the downloaded file. No arbitrary server path is accepted.

name: plc_device_add
description: Add or plug a device under an explicit parent using exact type/id/version/module. Device packages must already exist in the IDE.

name: plc_device_get_io_mappings
description: Enumerate mappable IO variables with stable connector/parameter/element addresses. Not EtherCAT PDO configuration.

name: plc_device_get_parameters
description: Enumerate offline device/connector parameters and nested element addresses, types, access rights and values; truncation is explicit.

name: plc_device_get_tree
description: Read device identities, module IDs and parent relationships. No online connection.

name: plc_device_remove
description: Remove a device in a candidate; explicitly acknowledge nonempty subtrees. The template controller and application roots are protected.

name: plc_device_set_io_mapping
description: Map one channel to a qualified existing variable, explicitly create an unqualified variable, or clear with an empty expression. Read back creation/existing mapping flags.

name: plc_device_set_parameter
description: Write one primitive offline parameter by device GUID and structural address. Check declared type, range/enum and offline access; never call online write APIs.

name: plc_dut_create
description: Create a Structure/Enumeration/Alias/Union DUT with a complete TYPE declaration. Alias requires baseType; array aliases can use an ARRAY type expression.

name: plc_dut_read
description: Read a DUT declaration by GUID from an explicit project version. No implementation text or graphical network is synthesized.

name: plc_dut_update
description: Replace a DUT declaration by GUID and verify persistence after reopening the candidate.

name: plc_exchange_read
description: Read an exchange artifact in bounded chunks; offsets are UTF-16 code units. Use returned nextOffset. Hash verification occurs on every read.

name: plc_exchange_stage
description: Stage bounded UTF-8 XML as an immutable artifact. Format is plcopen or codesys-native. Reject DTD/entities. Structure checks are not IDE validation or compilation.

name: plc_exchange_upload_abort
description: Remove upload staging data and its resume receipt. Completed immutable artifacts and project versions remain available.

name: plc_exchange_upload_append
description: Append at an exact byte offset, at most 32768 decoded bytes in base64. Retrying an already stored identical chunk is safe; mismatching data or offsets are errors. Offsets are bytes, not UTF-16 characters.

name: plc_exchange_upload_begin
description: Begin or resume a bounded XML upload using a stable key, UTF-8 byte length and SHA-256. Default capacity is 8 MiB, configurable up to 64 MiB. No project is modified.

name: plc_exchange_upload_complete
description: Verify complete upload length, SHA-256, strict UTF-8 and bounded XML structure, then create an immutable artifact. This does not import into an IDE or prove vendor compatibility.

name: plc_exchange_validate
description: Inspect format, POU names, languages, extensions and structural limits. This is not full XSD validation, dependency resolution or compilation.

name: plc_folder_create
description: Create a folder under a known object or project root. Return its actual GUID after creation.

name: plc_graph_decode
description: Decode exactly one graph-v1/v2 POU from an artifact. Refuse unrepresented extensions or program data; the original artifact remains available.

name: plc_graph_generate
description: Generate original PLCopen TC6 XML. Graph pouType is case-sensitive: program or functionBlock, plus function in graph-v2; never Program/PROGRAM. Language is LD/FBD/SFC. Exact node kinds: LD leftPowerRail,rightPowerRail,contact,coil,block,inVariable,outVariable; FBD block,inVariable,outVariable; SFC step,transition,jumpStep,actionBlock. graph-v2 additionally allows connector/continuation in LD/FBD and selectionDivergence/selectionConvergence/simultaneousDivergence/simultaneousConvergence in SFC. typeName and instanceName belong only on block nodes; inVariable/outVariable use expression and variables declared in program.variables. Default graph-v1 stays compatible; graph-v2 adds Function returnType, arrays/stringLength, labels, inOuts and structured SFC. Types accept enumValues [{name,value?}] (type=ENUM for implicit INT base, or explicit integer base) or subrange {lower,upper} with decimal string bounds; these are mutually exclusive. graph-v2 also supports type=STRUCT with structMembers [{name,type:{type,...},initialValue?,initializer?,address?,documentation?,documentationXhtml?}] and type=POINTER with pointerTo {type,...}; choose only one type form. Arrays use dimensions around the chosen type. Nesting is limited to 8 levels and 4096 type nodes; structs have at most 256 members. A variable's initializer supports kind=array with items(value,repeat) or kind=struct with members(name,value); nested leaves use kind=simple/value. Do not also set initialValue; arrays may be partially initialized but must fit declared capacity. graph-v2 variableGroups reference every variable name exactly once with matching scope; group order/boundaries, constant, retention(default/retain/nonRetain), independent persistence(default/persistent/nonPersistent), name and documentation are preserved. Persistent flags do not configure instance paths or prove runtime persistence. Variables and groups accept documentationXhtml instead of documentation; XHTML is bounded inert data and must preserve structure. Variables accept address and documentation; scopes include temp/external. Use empty pin name for non-block nodes. Connections belong on inputs, not outputs. Positive executionOrder is required on block/coil/outVariable and forbidden on inVariable/rails/SFC nodes. SFC step/transition have one output; jumpStep/actionBlock have none. An actionBlock has one input from its owning step and associations [{id,action,qualifier:N}]; the referenced action must be in program.actions as {name,implementation}. Omit unused optional fields; do not send null for qualifier/edge/storage. Do not combine associations with legacy action/qualifier/duration. Association list order is preserved, not a runtime execution guarantee. Target write checks apply Inovance restrictions separately. Selection output order, priorities 1..N and left-to-right X must agree. Validation errors name the offending field path where it can be identified; read the diagnostic before resubmitting. Return artifact and semantic hash; no IDE/compiler is run.

name: plc_gvl_create
description: Create a GVL with a complete VAR_GLOBAL declaration in a managed version; read back after save and reopen.

name: plc_gvl_read
description: Read a GVL declaration by GUID from an explicit project version. Returns a file revision; use plc_workspace_get for the managed editing revision.

name: plc_gvl_update
description: Replace a GVL declaration by GUID, preserving earlier immutable versions.

name: plc_job_cancel
description: Request cancellation. CancelRequested does not confirm executor termination; terminal jobs retain their existing outcome.

name: plc_job_get
description: Read a durable job state. A successful status query does not mean the engineering operation succeeded.

name: plc_job_get_result
description: Read a terminal result. Pending, failed, cancelled and unknown outcomes return isError=true, preserving available compile diagnostics.

name: plc_job_reconcile
description: Reconcile an unknown edit only from durable stopped-executor evidence and matching files. Does not rerun scripts, overwrite files or force-unlock an unproven outcome.

name: plc_library_add
description: Add a reference to one exact installed library display name. Fail when missing or ambiguous.

name: plc_library_list
description: Read references and placeholder resolution from an existing library manager. Does not create a manager during a read.

name: plc_library_list_installed
description: Query the IDE library repository. Exact display names include version/company. Does not install or uninstall libraries.

name: plc_library_remove
description: Remove an explicit project library reference by exact name; system references are protected.

name: plc_library_set_placeholder
description: Create/update a placeholder with explicit default resolution and/or redirection. Null leaves a setting unchanged; empty redirection clears it. Return effective resolution separately.

name: plc_object_delete
description: Delete an object in a candidate. Nonempty subtree requires recursive=true; protected roots and known task dependencies are rejected.

name: plc_object_inspect
description: Inspect a node, children and known task-call impacts. Use project for the root. This is not a compiler reference analysis.

name: plc_object_move
description: Move an object to a permitted parent with optional child index (-1 appends). Reject cycles, name collisions and known call dependencies.

name: plc_object_rename
description: Rename a non-system object after checking its current name and task-call references. Does not promise global source refactoring.

name: plc_pou_create
description: Create Program/FunctionBlock/Function under a parent GUID, save and reopen a new workspace version. ST/IL accept text; LD/FBD/SFC/CFC creation leaves graphical content empty. Function needs returnType; SFC Function is invalid.

name: plc_pou_graph_read
description: Read graph-v1/v2 LD/FBD/SFC content from an actual POU via PLCopen export. Return nodes, variables and semantic hash. Copy projectPath exactly from plc_workspace_get; never reconstruct, translate or rename any path segment. Unsupported extensions are explicit errors; use project export for opaque exchange.

name: plc_pou_graph_write
description: Create or replace a complete graph-v1/v2 POU from an artifact in a managed candidate. Updating requires objectId and expectedGraphSha256 from graph read. Name/type/language cannot change; unknown properties cannot be discarded. Validate/decode the artifact before writing; generation errors include field paths. A POU with child objects remains protected. Readback verifies logic before publication.

name: plc_pou_member_create
description: Create Method/Property/Action under an eligible parent. Property bodies are getter/setter sources. Null source leaves generated content unchanged; graph languages create empty content.

name: plc_pou_member_read
description: Read Method/Property/Action source by GUID, including Property Get/Set children. Kind selects the expected member shape.

name: plc_pou_member_update
description: Update member source by GUID and expected kind; save/reopen/readback the member and property accessors. Does not change its language or return type.

name: plc_pou_read
description: Queue reading a textual object's declaration and implementation by GUID. Graphical networks are not represented as source strings. Copy projectPath exactly from plc_workspace_get; never reconstruct, translate or rename any path segment.

name: plc_pou_update
description: Replace explicit declaration and/or textual implementation by GUID in an isolated candidate. Null leaves that part unchanged. Save/readback/reopen must succeed before publishing the new revision. Graphical networks cannot be replaced with text.

name: plc_project_adopt
description: Enroll a saved project as a new managed workspace. Requires the exact source revision from adopt_preview. Copy only declared files, check source before and after copying, validate dependencies, save/reopen the private candidate and publish an initial m2 revision. Original files remain untouched; this does not compile or certify PLC behavior.

name: plc_project_adopt_preview
description: Hash an existing saved project and explicitly listed companion files from WorkspaceRoot/imports/sourceName. Returns an a1 source revision for adoption. Unsaved external IDE state and undeclared dependencies are outside this inventory. No IDE is opened and no file is changed.

name: plc_project_batch_apply
description: Execute a previewed plan in one managed candidate. Resolve prior-step identities and refresh the object tree after each save/reopen. Shared device/library writes require task checks and compilation of every Application; other plans compile the chosen Application. Publish once. Failure preserves the old head; unknown outcomes are never automatically resumed.

name: plc_project_batch_preview
description: Preview up to 32 explicit engineering steps: POU/GVL/DUT, graph-v1/v2, text.patch, member.create/update, folder.create, object.rename/move/delete, task configuration/create/update/delete/calls, library.add/remove/placeholder.set, device.add/remove/parameter.write/io.map. Program operations stay in applicationId; devices require deviceScopeIds, external library managers require libraryManagerIds. Parent/object IDs and task-call pouId may use @stepId; source text is never interpolated. Member patches specify memberKind, Action also pins expectedTypeId, property accessors use Get/Set. Hashes cover full normalized source; oldText must match uniquely. Preview is static and does not open or validate the IDE.

name: plc_project_compile
description: Queue compilation of an explicit Application GUID. Acceptance is not compilation success. Fixture diagnostics are simulated.

name: plc_project_context
description: Read revision-bound Application engineering data (legacy query name; no AI session management) from a private copy: object IDs, source windows and full normalized SHA-256, task bindings and library references. Optional objectId is returned first; remaining Application objects, including GVL/DUT, follow across pages. Offset/pageSize select objects; textOffset/maxTextChars select UTF-16 source windows. Follow nextOffset and truncation flags. Explicit references are not a complete call graph. Read completion through plc_job_get.

name: plc_project_create
description: Create a managed workspace from a registered template or registered existing-project copy. Verify/save/reopen in a candidate; never overwrite the source. Fixture files are simulated.

name: plc_project_diff
description: Queue a comparison of two published revisions. File changes are exact hashes only. Optional objectId plus applicationId reads source before/after with hashes and bounded windows; graph=true compares supported graph-v1/v2 types, return values, variables, nodes, in/out pins, label connections, SFC branches, actions and ordering. Use toObjectId when XML replacement changed the vendor object GUID. Graphs outside the graph profiles return an explicit error. Offset/pageSize page file and graph changes; read completion through plc_job_get.

name: plc_project_export
description: Export selected GUIDs, subtrees or [project] through the official IDE API. Format plcopen or codesys-native. Results include an artifact, exact selection and reporter messages; no arbitrary output paths.

name: plc_project_get_structure
description: Queue a bounded project-tree read; poll its result. No project content is changed; a task record is created. Copy projectPath exactly from plc_workspace_get; never reconstruct, translate or rename any path segment.

name: plc_project_history
description: List published immutable revisions in chronological order, bound to an exact current head so concurrent publication cannot silently change pagination. Includes pre-P6 history. Failed candidates are job evidence, not historical published versions.

name: plc_project_import
description: Import a staged artifact into a managed candidate at a parent GUID or project. Conflict policy reject/replace/skip is explicit. Save/reopen/re-export proof precedes publication. Unknown/partial failures never publish; warnings require allowWarnings.

name: plc_project_objects_read
description: Read actual engineering data at an immutable revision, not AI conversation context. collection: objects (subtree/one object), members (direct children of parentId), tasks (explicit task bindings), libraries (selected Application and shared references). Returns source windows with full hashes and actual member/accessor identities. For Action classification use objectId plus sourceQuery with observed type GUID. Follow nextCursor with the same query/head/revision; cursor cannot be mixed with a different scope. Read the result with plc_job_get.

name: plc_project_open
description: Submit a project-open check. Each operation owns and closes its session; this does not keep a GUI project open. Fixture mode is simulated.

name: plc_project_restore
description: Restore historical project content by publishing a NEW revision, preserving every existing version. Requires the exact current head and an intact historical manifest. Validate historical dependencies, save/reopen a candidate, check tasks and compile every Application before publication. Failed or unknown execution never advances the head; unknown outcomes stay quarantined.

name: plc_project_save
description: Finalize a new delivery snapshot: save and reopen a copy of the current managed version. Earlier edits already persist to working versions. Delivery does not imply compilation, task binding or PLC runtime correctness.

name: plc_runtime_get_status
description: Report local tool availability, reviewed operation scopes, identity failures and scheduler state. No persistent IDE connection or PLC runtime guarantee is implied.

name: plc_task_configuration_create
description: Create the Task Configuration under an Application if absent; no PLC online action.

name: plc_task_create
description: Create a task under an existing Task Configuration, with explicit kind, units, priority and watchdog.

name: plc_task_delete
description: Remove a task from a candidate version after checking its current name. Older versions remain available.

name: plc_task_list
description: Read task configurations and tasks under an explicit Application. Preserve call order and units.

name: plc_task_read
description: Read one task with its settings and ordered program calls.

name: plc_task_set_calls
description: Replace the complete ordered task call list. Empty array unbinds all. Each call supplies the Program GUID, name and comment; rejects ambiguous names and non-Program POUs.

name: plc_task_update
description: Replace task scheduling settings. Omitted watchdog/core binding remain unchanged; kind-specific fields must be valid.

name: plc_templates_list
description: List registered templates and declared-file revisions. IDE profile, controller and libraries are declared requirements, not verified installed dependencies.

name: plc_workspace_get
description: Get the managed workspace's current manifest revision and immutable project path. Use this revision for editing; file-read revisions are a separate scope. Reuse the returned projectPath verbatim in read tools, including Unicode and spaces; do not guess, translate or expand directory names.
